subject: Matemática
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas de multiplicação (por 2, 3, 4, 5 e 10) com os significados de adição de parcelas iguais e elementos apresentados em disposição retangular, utilizando diferentes estratégias de cálculo e registros.

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas de multiplicação envolvendo adição repetida com fatores 2, 3, 4, 5 e 10
components.description_en: Solve multiplication problems involving repeated addition using factors of 2, 3, 4, 5, and 10
components.cc_component_description: Use repeated addition patterns to generalize the concept of multiplication

components.description_pt: Compor um problema de multiplicação representando adição repetida ou disposição retangular
components.description_en: Compose a multiplication problem representing a repeated addition or rectangular array situation
components.cc_component_description: Model a multiplication situation, including by writing a multiplication expression

components.description_pt: Aplicar e registrar diferentes estratégias para calcular fatos de multiplicação com fatores 2, 3, 4, 5 e 10
components.description_en: Apply and record different strategies for calculating multiplication facts with factors of 2, 3, 4, 5, and 10
components.cc_component_description: Identify patterns in multiplication tables to infer relationships between factors and products

cc_matches.description: Look for and express regularity in repeated reasoning.
Look for and make use of structure.

Interpret products of whole numbers, e.g., interpret $5 \times 7$ as the total number of objects in 5 groups of 7 objects each. *For example, describe a context in which a total number of objects can be expressed as $5 \div 7$.*
